description: This file contains LESS mixins for handling responsive and retina images, including styles and media queries for different device pixel ratios.

methods.name: .img-responsive
methods.description: Mixin to keep images within their container width, setting display, max-width, and height for responsiveness.

methods.name: .img-retina
methods.description: Mixin to set background images suitable for retina displays using media queries for high pixel ratio screens.
